gloss: sense of crisis; sense of urgency

definitions.gloss: sense of crisis; sense of urgency
definitions.explanation: The awareness that a situation is dangerous or critical and that something must be done.

examples.japanese: {危機感|ききかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: To have a sense of urgency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{危機感|ききかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: They don't feel the urgency of the situation.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急減|きゅうげん}→急減：29369_kyuugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{危機感|ききかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いた→抱く：02010_idaku⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}した→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧。
examples.english: Alarmed by the sharp fall in sales, the president set about reforming the company.

notes:
⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (crisis) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling). Often used to criticize a lack of it: {危機感|ききかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (complacent), {危機感|ききかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧.
